summary: Implemented KAFKA-20497: ReadOnlyView implementations for MeteredWindowStore. Added a readOnly(IsolationLevel isolationLevel) method that returns a custom ReadOnlyView inner class implementing ReadOnlyWindowStore<K, V>. The ReadOnlyView wraps the inner store's read-only view and implements all required methods (fetch point-in-time, range fetches, backward operations, all() operations) with proper serde application and metrics recording. All 40 tests in MeteredWindowStoreTest pass successfully.
